//@version=6
// ============================================================
//  QUANT PRIME · RESEARCH BUILD RES-3231
//  Prior Week + Volatility + Hourly Profile + Weekly Summary
//  Prior week H/L/C, Volatility state meter, Time-of-day range profile, Weekly analysis template
//
//  Generated file. Do not edit.
//  Edit the source piece and regenerate.
//  quantprime.uk
// ============================================================
indicator("QP RES-3231 · Prior Week + Volatility + Hourly Profile + Weekly Summary", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st3_on   = input.bool(true,      "Show prior week H/L/C",        group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cHi  = input.color(#c9a84c,  "High",  inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cLo  = input.color(#00abff,  "Low",   inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cCl  = input.color(#9aa0a6,  "Close", inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")

[st3_h, st3_l, st3_c] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", [high[1], low[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st3_on ? st3_h : na, "PW High",  color = st3_cHi, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st3_on ? st3_l : na, "PW Low",   color = st3_cLo, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st3_on ? st3_c : na, "PW Close", color = st3_cCl, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)

// ---------- MAIN ----------
mn2_on    = input.bool(true, "Show volatility state",        group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_len   = input.int(14,    "ATR length",   minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_look  = input.int(500,   "Lookback",     minval = 50,    group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_lo    = input.int(30,    "Low below %",  minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_hi    = input.int(70,    "High above %", minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_sz    = input.string("Tiny", "Volatility text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_pos   = input.string("Top right", "Volatility table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Main · Volatility state")

mn2_atr   = ta.atr(mn2_len)
mn2_rank  = ta.percentrank(mn2_atr, mn2_look)
mn2_word  = mn2_rank < mn2_lo ? "LOW" : mn2_rank > mn2_hi ? "HIGH" : "NORMAL"
mn2_col   = mn2_rank < mn2_lo ? #9aa0a6 : mn2_rank > mn2_hi ? #c9a84c : #00abff

mn2_size  = mn2_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : mn2_sz == "Small" ? size.small : mn2_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large

mn2_where = mn2_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : mn2_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : mn2_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table mn2_tbl = table.new(mn2_where, 2, 2, border_width = 0)
if mn2_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 0, 0, "VOLATILITY", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 1, 0, mn2_word,     text_color = mn2_col, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 0, 1, "PERCENTILE", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 1, 1, str.tostring(mn2_rank, "#") + "%", text_color = #f2f0ea, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

// ---------- SIDE ----------
sd3_on   = input.bool(true, "Show time-of-day profile",     group = "Side · Time-of-day profile")
sd3_days = input.int(30,    "Days of history", minval = 5,  group = "Side · Time-of-day profile")
sd3_sz   = input.string("Tiny", "Profile text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Side · Time-of-day profile")
sd3_pos  = input.string("Bottom right", "Profile table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Side · Time-of-day profile")

var array<float> sd3_sum = array.new_float(24, 0.0)
var array<int>   sd3_cnt = array.new_int(24, 0)

sd3_cut = timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth, 0, 0) - sd3_days * 86400000
if time >= sd3_cut
    sd3_h = hour(time, syminfo.timezone)
    array.set(sd3_sum, sd3_h, array.get(sd3_sum, sd3_h) + (high - low))
    array.set(sd3_cnt, sd3_h, array.get(sd3_cnt, sd3_h) + 1)

sd3_size = sd3_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : sd3_sz == "Small" ? size.small : sd3_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large

sd3_where = sd3_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : sd3_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : sd3_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table sd3_tbl = table.new(sd3_where, 2, 25, border_width = 0)
if sd3_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(sd3_tbl, 0, 0, "HOUR", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = sd3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(sd3_tbl, 1, 0, "AVG RANGE", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = sd3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    sd3_max = 0.0
    for sd3_i = 0 to 23
        sd3_c = array.get(sd3_cnt, sd3_i)
        sd3_v = sd3_c > 0 ? array.get(sd3_sum, sd3_i) / sd3_c : 0.0
        sd3_max := math.max(sd3_max, sd3_v)
    for sd3_i = 0 to 23
        sd3_c = array.get(sd3_cnt, sd3_i)
        sd3_v = sd3_c > 0 ? array.get(sd3_sum, sd3_i) / sd3_c : 0.0
        sd3_col = sd3_max > 0 and sd3_v >= sd3_max * 0.75 ? #c9a84c : #9aa0a6
        table.cell(sd3_tbl, 0, sd3_i + 1, str.tostring(sd3_i) + ":00", text_color = #9aa0a6, text_size = sd3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
        table.cell(sd3_tbl, 1, sd3_i + 1, str.tostring(sd3_v, format.mintick), text_color = sd3_col, text_size = sd3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

// ---------- DESSERT ----------
ds1_on  = input.bool(true, "Show weekly summary", group = "Dessert · Weekly summary", tooltip = "A plain summary of the current trading week: where it opened, how far price has moved since, how wide the week's range is, and whereabouts in that range price is sitting now.")
ds1_sz  = input.string("Tiny", "Weekly table text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Dessert · Weekly summary")
ds1_pos = input.string("Bottom left", "Weekly table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Dessert · Weekly summary")

[ds1_o, ds1_h, ds1_l, ds1_c, ds1_po, ds1_pc] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", [open, high, low, close, open[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

ds1_chg   = ds1_o > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_c - ds1_o) / ds1_o : 0.0
ds1_rng   = ds1_h - ds1_l
ds1_inr   = ds1_rng > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_c - ds1_l) / ds1_rng : 0.0
ds1_pchg  = ds1_po > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_pc - ds1_po) / ds1_po : 0.0
ds1_where_in = ds1_inr >= 70 ? "near the high" : ds1_inr <= 30 ? "near the low" : "mid range"
ds1_sign(v) =>
    (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(v, "#.##") + "%"

ds1_size = ds1_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : ds1_sz == "Small" ? size.small : ds1_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large
ds1_where = ds1_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : ds1_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : ds1_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table ds1_t = table.new(ds1_where, 2, 6, border_width = 0)
ds1_row(r, k, v, c) =>
    table.cell(ds1_t, 0, r, k, text_color = #6b7280, text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds1_t, 1, r, v, text_color = c,       text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

if ds1_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(ds1_t, 0, 0, "THIS WEEK", text_color = #c9a84c, text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds1_t, 1, 0, "", bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    ds1_row(1, "Opened at",        str.tostring(ds1_o, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(2, "Moved since open", ds1_sign(ds1_chg), ds1_chg >= 0 ? #c9a84c : #d27050)
    ds1_row(3, "Week's range",     str.tostring(ds1_rng, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(4, "Price sitting",    str.tostring(ds1_inr, "#") + "% up, " + ds1_where_in, #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(5, "Last week ended",  ds1_sign(ds1_pchg), ds1_pchg >= 0 ? #c9a84c : #d27050)
